newsitem.title: USA: ACE*COMM to supply systems to Korean group.
newsitem.headline: ACE*COMM to supply systems to Korean group.

text.p: ACE*COMM Corp Thursday said it will provide engineering, hardware, and related services to a consortium of Korean companies who are the network switching suppliers to Korea Telecom.
The firms include Iljin Corp, LG Group's LG Information & Communications Co, and Samsung Electronics Co Ltd .
Terms of the deal were not disclosed.
Korea Telecom has a monopoly on local telephone service in the Republic of Korea, and holds a large share of the long distance and data communications markets.
ACE*COMM said it will supply those companies with billing data collection systems and software, after successful completion of verification tests by Korea Telecom.
